option_txt: Quando officium dicitur noctu vel summo mane
evidence: p577 bottom (Feria VI, Off. lect. H) prints rubric 'Quando officium dicitur noctu vel summo mane:' which continues at top of p578 with 'Tu Trinitatis Unitas (LHym 203)'; then 'Quando officium dicitur diurno tempore: Adesto Christe (LHym 204)' (the diurno hymn, option 1 = gregobase:15623). So this row (gregobase:15622, Tu Trinitatis) is the noctu alternative.
